title: Himerius, Orations (Λόγοι), about 80 speeches and fragments / Гимерий, Речи
author: Himerius
size: About 80 orations, many fragmentary or in Photian excerpts; Colonna edition about 270 pages (estimate)
edition: Colonna 1951 (in copyright). Public domain: Dübner (Didot 1849) and Wernsdorf 1790.
ru_evidence: Russian Wikipedia 'Гимерий': only Or. 1, 3, 23 (Поздняя греческая проза, 1960) and Or. 12, 17, 18, 24 plus Ecl. 17 (Памятники... 1964).
en_evidence: R. J. Penella, Man and the Word: The Orations of Himerius (University of California Press 2007), a complete translation (from memory; not re-checked online).
other_translations: Italian and German partial versions exist (unverified).
value: Athenian sophist, teacher of Basil and Gregory of Nazianzus, linked to Julian. Key for 4th-century Athenian education, student life, and prose-hymn and propemptikon forms.
ai_feasibility: Medium-high. Poetic, image-laden prose and fragmentary excerpts; Penella can be used for cross-checking.
pilot_unit: Ten short school orations not among the Russian-translated Or. 1, 3, 12, 17, 18, 23, 24 (about 10,000 words).
